entries.text: 梅洛可？
entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_01

entries.text: 哪位！？
entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_02

entries.text: 我是梅洛可啊，梅洛可。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一看就知道了吧！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_03

entries.text: 說起來我現在的打扮\n跟平常不一樣啊。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_04

entries.text: 這是……因為枇琶姐\n說要穿制服參加讀書會，\r\n我才不得已穿成這個樣子的。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_05

entries.text: 我來叫妳的
entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_03

entries.text: 我來單挑的
entries.label: s2_sub_009_select_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是想把我叫到校舍後面嗎？\n很有幹勁嘛～[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_07

entries.text: 單挑……\c\n抱歉啊，我現在沒那種心情。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_08

entries.text: ……什麼啊，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是要把我拖回教室啊。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_09

entries.text: 我看著看著蔬菜，\n時間就這麼過去了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_10

entries.text: 梅洛，妳回來了！\n真高興妳願意回來！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_01

entries.text: 妳跑到哪裡去偷懶了？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_01

entries.text: 嗯……就溜達溜達。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_13

entries.text: 好啦好啦，沒關係嘛。\n大家都到齊了就好！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_01

entries.text: 時間很寶貴，\n總之我們開始讀書會吧！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_02

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]老師，請多指教了！\n拜託[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳教他們３個人功課吧。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_03

entries.text: 我會播放能讓大家\n專心用功的ＢＧＭ的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_npc

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]還有大家，\n你們都要加油喔！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_npc

entries.text: 這什麼東東啊……\n完全搞不懂。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_01

entries.text: 觀望一下
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_select_01

entries.text: 晚點再說
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_select_02

entries.text: 竟敢高高在上地看我，\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳很有膽量嘛。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_02

entries.text: 先跟[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳說清楚，我是２年級！\n是[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的學長！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_20

entries.text: ……但既然枇琶姐那樣說了，\n就讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳教我吧。我不擅長文科。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_03

entries.text: 像是故事裡的角色的心情什麼的，\n我根本搞不懂啊……！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_04

entries.text: 這個故事的主角，一家鼠媽媽\n牠到底是用什麼樣的感情\r\n說一家鼠爸爸是個「討厭鬼」啊？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_05

entries.text:
一家鼠媽媽的眼眶濕濕的。
因為牠讀了一家鼠爸爸留下的信之後，
知道再也無法見到牠了。
「直到最後一刻你都要擾亂我的心，
你真是個……[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]討厭鬼[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。」
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_book_01

entries.text: 真的很討厭牠
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_01

entries.text: 其實很喜歡牠
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_02

entries.text: 不清楚真意
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_select_03

entries.text: 哼～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有點本事嘛！！\n原來就是字面上的意思啊！\r\n唉～啊，想太多反而白費力氣了！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_06

entries.text: 不不！雖然我只是個旁聽的，但我覺得啊，\n那麼一來就不用出這個問題了吧？\r\n好像……錯了吧……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_01

entries.text: 喂，皮拿都這麼說了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的靠得住嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_07

entries.text: ……搞不好[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我一樣，\n對人的感情很遲鈍！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_08

entries.text: 我知道[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有多少實力了！\n我想一個人專心，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳快回去吧，老師。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_09

entries.text: 啥！？嘴上說討厭，心裡卻喜歡！？\n喜歡的話，直接說喜歡不就好了！\r\n那絕對不是正確答案！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_10

entries.text: 不不！\n奧爾迪加你不也是一樣嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_02

entries.text: 啥？你什麼意思？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_11

entries.text: 你其實早就認同[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她了，\n但嘴巴還是不饒人不是嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_03

entries.text: 啥～！？\n我哪有認同這傢伙！！\r\n沒有沒有！絕對沒有！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_12

entries.text:
……也就是說，
不論是誰都會有種感情，\c
讓心裡想的是一回事，
脫口說出的卻是相反的事囉。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_14

entries.text: 哼！我大概稍微理解了！\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，就感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳一下吧。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_15

entries.text: 哼～[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有點本事嘛！！\n那的確就是真理啊！\r\n怎麼可能讀得懂別人的內心！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_16

entries.text: 不不！雖然我只是個旁聽的，但我覺得啊，\n那麼一來就不用出這個問題了吧？\r\n好像……錯了吧……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_aku_04

entries.text: 喂，皮拿都這麼說了。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真的靠得住嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_17

entries.text: ……搞不好[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳跟我一樣，\n對人的感情很遲鈍！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_18

entries.text: 我知道[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳有多少實力了！\n我想一個人專心，\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳快回去吧，老師。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_19

entries.text: 嗯～下一個問題……\n主題是操陷蛛三兄弟之間\r\n剪不斷理還亂的家庭關係啊。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_f_fairy_npc

entries.text: 在下知己所不知，\n此乃無知之知也……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_01

entries.text: You要作為老師，\n向在下伸出援手……嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_02

entries.text: 在下不擅長算術，\n所以對數學一竅不通。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_04

entries.text: 然而在下將來要成為\n服裝設計師，\r\n故數字概念對在下毫無用處。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_05

entries.text: 說得對
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_01

entries.text: 才不是那樣
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_02

entries.text: 果然[VAR 0x0100(0000)]閣下也\n與在下意見相同啊。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_06

entries.text: 在下認為不如放棄算術，\n學習忍術會更有意義！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_07

entries.text: 正是如此！
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_03

entries.text: 才不是那樣
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_select_04

entries.text: 哦……\n究竟是哪裡不是那樣？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_08

entries.text: 製作天星隊的改造版制服時，\n可花了不少錢……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_02

entries.text: 為了製作好東西，\n付出money是理所當然。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_09

entries.text: 但最後布料之類的都還有剩，\n說不定其實可以再省下一點費用？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_03

entries.text: 衣服尺寸、材料費用……\n如果要做生意的話，還有售價和利潤率……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_11

entries.text: 能考慮到這些要素的設計師，\n就能在工匠中出人頭地！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_12

entries.text: 在下這忽視現實的想法……\n或許是一個錯誤。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_13

entries.text: 明白了！\n在下這就去把手裡劍拿來。\r\n我們去外面射手裡劍來玩！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_14

entries.text: 秋明，不行喔！\n得好好用功啊！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_04

entries.text: 可、可是，枇琶閣下，\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]閣下已允許在下學習忍術……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_15

entries.text: 我說啊，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我希望[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不要說些會讓大家\r\n失去幹勁的話……抱歉喔。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_05

entries.text: 枇琶閣下的尊容看起來很悲傷……\n在下的選擇錯了……？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_16

entries.text: 如此一來，即使有違在下意願，\n在下也得面對算術才行……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_17

entries.text: 唔唔，不至於那麼有意義嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_18

entries.text: 可惡的算術，\n定位是如此奇異……！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_19

entries.text: 秋明！\n你想得太複雜了。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_06

entries.text: 不論是誰都會有不擅長的事，\n也都會遇上碰壁的時候。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_07

entries.text: 但是啊！所以，呃……\n能勇敢面對那些事的人，\r\n我覺得很有魅力喔～[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_08

entries.text: 在下就此洗心革面……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_21

entries.text: 竭盡全力在算術之道邁進！！\n唔喔喔喔喔喔喔喔！！！！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_22

entries.text: 可惡的分數除法……\n為何要天地顛倒！？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_doku_npc

entries.text: 抱歉，我不應該插嘴的！\n但是看來因為[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳，\r\n秋明他拿出幹勁了！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_09

entries.text: 對於有興趣的事，\n秋明他會一股腦兒鑽進去。\r\n一旦他進入那個狀態就沒問題了！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_10

entries.text: 看來秋明總算是\n提起幹勁了。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_11

entries.text: 不過他心不甘情不願的，\n或許不能期待會有好成果。\r\n……有點可惜呢。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_d_kakutou_12

entries.text: 我在做考古題。\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳幫我看看吧。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_03

entries.text: 「只能透過捕捉或交換，\n才能遇見新的寶可夢。」\r\n……這是正確的嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_04

entries.text: 正確
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_01

entries.text: 不正確
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_02

entries.text: ……啊？寶可夢從蛋裡孵出來的時候，\n不也能遇見寶可夢嗎？\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是在瞧不起蛋嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_05

entries.text: 果然啊……畢竟從蛋裡孵出來的時候，\n也可以遇見寶可夢嘛。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_06

entries.text: 「當寶可夢太晶化時，\n 在牠頭上發光的寶石叫什麼？」[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_08

entries.text: 太晶寶石
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_03

entries.text: 太晶石
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_04

entries.text: 太晶礦石
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_05

entries.text: 就是叫那個名字沒錯！\n誰叫[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是有太晶珠的人啊。\r\n挺有兩下子的嘛！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_09

entries.text: 太晶石？\n是叫這麼土的名字嗎？\r\n我沒聽過耶……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_10

entries.text: 太晶礦石？\n唸起來是很像那麼一回事，\r\n但是我沒有聽過那東西……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_11

entries.text: 太晶化有夠帥的啊。\n不過得要是優秀的學生，\r\n才能拿到太晶珠就是了。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_12

entries.text: 雖然和考試沒有關係，\n但我有事想問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_14

entries.text: 這還真有點難說出口……\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳絕對……不准笑喔！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_15

entries.text: 那個啊……\n所謂的「夢」……到底是什麼？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_16

entries.text: 睡著後會看見的那個？
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_06

entries.text: 將來的目標？
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_07

entries.text: 啊哈哈哈哈
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_08

entries.text: 不是那個「夢」啦！！\n我說的是想做的事啦，目標啦，\r\n那方面的事！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_17

entries.text: 就是那個！將來的事！\n比如說將來想成為什麼之類的！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_18

entries.text: 我都說[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不准笑了！！\c\n我再也不會問[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳了啦！！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_19

entries.text: 我完全不知道\n自己將來想成為什麼～……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_20

entries.text: 天星隊裡有很多人\n都有自己的夢想。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_21

entries.text: 就算是植物，\n也會拼命向上生長不是嗎？\r\n所以最近我很羨慕蔬菜……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_22

entries.text: 要是只有我\n一直找不到夢想的話……\r\n一想到這，我不禁就覺得害怕。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_23

entries.text: 有一天會找到的！
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_09

entries.text: 美術呢？
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_10

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真是樂觀得\n像個傻瓜一樣啊……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_24

entries.text: ……但說得也是，\n著急也沒用嘛。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_25

entries.text: ……啥？[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳怎麼知道\n我加入了美術社？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_26

entries.text: 說起來，美術只是我\n喜歡搞的興趣罷了啊？\r\n那東西怎麼能當工作……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_27

entries.text: 不對……仔細想想，\n當顧問的老龍也是把美術當工作嘛。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_28

entries.text: 他看起來過得超～開心的，\n讓我都沒注意到他是在工作。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_29

entries.text: 我喜歡畫畫，\n要是能讓它變成工作，那就太酷啦……[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_30

entries.text: 這種事也可以說……\n是我的夢想嗎？[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_31

entries.text: 當然
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_11

entries.text: 不行
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_select_12

entries.text: 喂，這種時候\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳該回答「當然」才對吧！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_32

entries.text: 這樣啊……\n這就是我的夢想啊！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_33

entries.text: 我覺得……\n整個人都充滿幹勁啦！\r\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，謝謝啊！！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_34

entries.text: 唉！沒[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的事了。\n讓我專心讀書吧。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_35

entries.text: 好不容易回到學校來了，\n被趕出去的話，我可笑不出來。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_study_h_honoo_36

entries.text: 之後，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]又繼續\n教梅洛可他們功課……
entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_01

entries.text: 讀書會差不多該進入尾奏囉！\n既然正好告一段落，就到此結束吧。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_04

entries.text: 大家辛苦了～！\n書讀得如何呢？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_03

entries.text: 感覺進展神速耶！\n想不到[VAR 0x0100(0000)][VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她\r\n還有點值得認同的地方嘛。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_02

entries.text: ……嗯，就差不多囉。\n或許根本不需要老師。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_03

entries.text: 只要仔細鑽研，算術也著實挺有趣的！\n在老師的教導之下，\r\n在下的幹勁宛如獲得毒素的普隆隆姆啊！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_02

entries.text: 今後千秋萬代，\n在下都不願再與數字相見。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_03

entries.text: 感覺就像眼前被使出了\n清除濃霧一樣，\r\n知識清清楚楚地進入腦袋裡了！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_14

entries.text: 很難說……\n只能說補考範圍的知識\r\n算是勉強塞進腦袋裡了啦。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_15

entries.text: 大家太棒了～！\n看來這是大家最專心的一次！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_04

entries.text: 嗯嗯，這樣啊！\n看大家的反應，\r\n補考應該是能低空飛過了！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_06

entries.text: 進展得似乎不是很順利？\n讓人有些擔心呢……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_07

entries.text: 這是感謝[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來當老師的謝禮！\n希望[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳能收下。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_09

entries.text:
另外……
還得到了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]改造版制服ＴＹＰＥ１[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、\c
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]改造版制服ＴＹＰＥ２[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]天星眼鏡[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]天星手套[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、\c
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]天星低跟鞋[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]天星安全帽[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]、
[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]天星隊手機殼[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_02

entries.text: 我們一起來比一下那個\n熟悉無比的姿勢吧！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_14

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]從枇琶那裡\n學會了[VAR 0xFF00(0008)]今天星苦了～表情[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: s2_sub_009_system_03

entries.text: 欸，這……\n大家在做什麼！？[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_01

entries.text: 哎呀～被發現了啊。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_04

entries.text: 呃……我走過走廊的時候，\n看到大家都在這……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_02

entries.text: 可、可是可是！既然人家沒被找來，\n就還是不要在這裡比較好對吧！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_03

entries.text: 不是的，牡丹！\n妳聽我說！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_10

entries.text: 其實是這樣那樣那樣這樣……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_06

entries.text: 呼……人家還以為是\n只有自己被排擠了。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_05

entries.text: 我們怎麼可能會做那種事！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_11

entries.text: ……不過，我們害妳誤會了吧。\n對不起，讓妳擔心了。[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_kakutou_12

entries.text: 我們是不想給妳添麻煩。\n……抱歉喔，牡丹。[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_16

entries.text: 不……人家才不原諒呢！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_06

entries.text: 說什麼會添麻煩！！\n真是的！！莫名其妙！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_07

entries.text: 人家也是大家的\n夥……夥伴啊……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_08

entries.text: 盡量添麻煩，\n多讓人家擔心你們……嘛。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_09

entries.text: 萬、萬一補考沒過的話，\n人家可以駭進系統竄改大家的成績的！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_10

entries.text: 牡丹啊，\n那樣做可就太過火了吧……[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_07

entries.text: ……啊，抱歉，\n剛剛那只是想開個玩笑。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_11

entries.text: 人家原本是要逗大家笑一下，\n想不到就誤入歧途了……[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_12

entries.text: 哈！如果妳是認真的，\n我可要一掌巴下去啦！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_17

entries.text: 可、可是可是！功課的話，\n人家也能教大家啊。[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_13

entries.text: 隨時都可以來問問題喔！！[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_botan_14

entries.text: 牡丹閣下……\n在下不勝感激。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_06

entries.text: 唉～啊！接下來得要面對[VAR 0x0100(0000)]\n和牡丹兩個聯手起來逼我們啊。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_06

entries.text: ……算了，說不定那也不錯。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_07

entries.text: 啊哈哈！奧爾迪加你\n也真是太不坦率了吧！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_08

entries.text: 你明明就覺得那似乎很有趣！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_aku_09

entries.text: 嗯，這麼容易讓人一眼看穿，\n在下都要看不下去了。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_doku_07

entries.text: 啥～！？我才沒有那樣想！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_08

entries.text: 你們根本\n一點都不懂我！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_09

entries.text: 你們該要更了解我啊！\n真不爽，真不爽，太不爽啦～！！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_fairy_10

entries.text: 你到底幾歲啊……噗！！[VAR 0x0114(001F)]
entries.label: s2_sub_009_honoo_18

entries.text: 啊哈哈哈哈哈……！！
entries.label: s2_sub_009_all_01
